title: Rewards Ledger Standard: Methods for the Points to Reverse on a Grooming Pass Refund
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** When a grooming pass that earned points is cancelled and its unused visits are refunded, the points to reverse are first worked out by one of three methods.

**Method 1 — refund during an unpaid billing period.** A refund dated on or after the latest declined-fee entry on the rewards history, with no membership fee charged from that entry's date through the refund date, is reversed at 8 points per refunded dollar, rounded down to a whole point.

**Method 2 — earning from before the current tier.** A refund that does not meet the method 1 condition, of a pass whose earning is dated before the date the currently held tier took effect, is reversed at the base earn rate of the tier now held per refunded dollar, rounded down.

**Method 3 — any other refund** is reversed in proportion: the points the pass purchase earned times the amount refunded divided by the pass purchase's qualifying spend, rounded down to a whole point.

| Latest declined-fee entry on or before the refund date, and no fee charged from it through the refund date | Pass earning dated before the held tier's effective date | Method |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | 8 points per refunded dollar |
| no (or no declined-fee entry at all) | yes | held tier's base rate per refunded dollar |
| no | no | proportional |

**Worked figures (hypothetical, $97.50 refunded; pass earned 1,560 points on $130.00).**
- Method 1: 97.50 times 8 is 780 points.
- Method 2, tier now held Pals Rewards VIP (12 per dollar): 97.50 times 12 is 1,170 points.
- Method 3: 1,560 times 97.50 divided by 130.00 is 1,170 points.
- With $33.33 refunded, method 1 gives 266.64, rounded down to 266.
